# sapintegrationsuite_value_mapping (Data Source)

Reads an existing Cloud Integration value mapping's metadata by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sapintegrationsuite_value_mapping" "company_codes" {
  package_id = "UTILITIES"
  mapping_id = "company-codes"
}

output "company_codes_value_mapping_version" {
  value = data.sapintegrationsuite_value_mapping.company_codes.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mapping_id` (String) The value mapping's technical ID.
- `package_id` (String) ID of the integration package the value mapping belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the form "<package_id>/<mapping_id>".
- `name` (String) The value mapping's display name.
- `version` (String) The design-time version SAP reports for this value mapping.
